title: Street posters / The Winter’s Tale

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use portrait relationships to communicate drama because faces can establish emotional stakes quickly.
strategic_value: Two opposing profiles can give the Shakespeare production immediate human presence at sidewalk scale.
demonstration: The foreground white poster places two facing profiles around THE WINTER’S TALE; Nina Hendrix and another portrait-led poster recede behind.
practical_value: Compare how two faces frame a title while remaining readable from the street.

content_islands.name: Foreground poster
content_islands.spec: Place the profiles at opposite sides of the tall title.

content_islands.name: Receding posters
content_islands.spec: Retain the neighboring campaign panels and stone facade as scale and context.

reference_purposes.Expression: The foreground white poster places two facing profiles around THE WINTER’S TALE; Nina Hendrix and another portrait-led poster recede behind.
reference_purposes.Application: The Winter’s Tale appears in an outdoor display beside other portrait-based production campaigns.
